question: Select the wrongly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e. **'Camor'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The wrongly spelled word here is **"Camor".**
 
• The **correct spelling** for this word could be **"Camaro"**, a model of car, or **"Camaraderie"** which means mutual trust and friendship among people who spend a lot of time together.(सखा-पन)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: '**Camor'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss all the words:
 
 
• **Circumspect: **This term is used to describe someone who is cautious or wary, unwilling to take risks.(सतर्क)
 
• **Cloying: **Cloying is used to describe something that is sickeningly sweet, in the sense of being excessively sentimental or flattering. (खींचाव युक्त)
 
• **Coffer:** A coffer is a box or chest to hold valuable items. In a broader context, it can also refer to the funds or financial reserves of a group or institution.(संदूक)
